sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>false</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>incident</collection><condition/><description>Sends new incidents to the IT KB Assistant ticket agent (AWS).</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>KB Assistant - AI work note</name><order>1000</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[/**
 * Business Rule: "KB Assistant - AI work note"
 * Table: incident | Insert: true | When: async_always (background job queue, so saving never waits)
 *   or after (runs right after the save; the webhook only queues and answers in under a second, and the
 *   5-second timeout below caps the worst case). Use "after" if the instance's job queue is backlogged.
 *
 * Sends only the incident's sys_id and number to the AWS webhook. The worker then reads the incident
 * itself through the Table API, so no incident text travels in this request.
 * The request is signed: HMAC-SHA256 over "<timestamp>.<body>" with the shared key, which AWS
 * verifies (and rejects anything older than 5 minutes).
 *
 * System properties (created by scripts/servicenow_setup.py):
 *   kb_assistant.webhook_url   the stack's ServiceNowWebhookUrl output
 *   kb_assistant.signing_key   base64 HMAC key (marked Private, so it is never exported in update sets)
 */
(function executeRule(current, previous /* null when async */) {
    var endpoint = gs.getProperty('kb_assistant.webhook_url', '');
    var key = gs.getProperty('kb_assistant.signing_key', '');
    if (!endpoint || !key) {
        gs.warn('KB Assistant: webhook URL or signing key is not configured; skipping ' + current.getValue('number'));
        return;
    }
    var body = JSON.stringify({ sys_id: current.getUniqueValue(), number: current.getValue('number') });
    var timestamp = String(Math.floor(new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue() / 1000));
    var signature = new GlideCertificateEncryption().generateMac(key, 'HmacSHA256', timestamp + '.' + body);

    try {
        var request = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2();
        request.setEndpoint(endpoint);
        request.setHttpMethod('post');
        request.setHttpTimeout(5000);
        request.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
        request.setRequestHeader('X-Timestamp', timestamp);
        request.setRequestHeader('X-Signature', signature);
        request.setRequestBody(body);
        var response = request.execute();
        var status = response.getStatusCode();
        if (status != 202 && status != 200) {
            gs.warn('KB Assistant webhook returned HTTP ' + status + ' for ' + current.getValue('number') +
                    ': ' + response.getBody());
        }
    } catch (e) {
        // Never block or break the incident: log and move on. The incident works normally without AI.
        gs.error('KB Assistant webhook failed for ' + current.getValue('number') + ': ' + e);
    }
})(current, previous);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>svc_kb_setup</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-19 17:06:34</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>fe501e5d73c0d71048fffb914ab8b784</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>KB Assistant - AI work note</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_fe501e5d73c0d71048fffb914ab8b784</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>svc_kb_setup</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-19 23:17:50</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=fe501e5d73c0d71048fffb914ab8b784"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>incident</collection><condition/><description>When the caller replies to the AI agent's fix, lets the agent resolve or hand it back.</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>KB Assistant - caller reply</name><order>1000</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[/**
 * Business Rule: "KB Assistant - caller reply"
 * Table: incident | Update: true | When: after (needs `previous`, which async rules don't have)
 *
 * When the AI agent has sent a fix and put the incident On Hold - Awaiting Caller, and the caller
 * then adds a comment, tell AWS so the agent can read the reply: confirmed -> Resolved, anything
 * else -> back to a technician. Signed exactly like the new-incident rule; only ids are sent.
 * Fires only for the caller's own comments; AWS re-checks the author against the caller.
 */
(function executeRule(current, previous) {
    if (!previous || !current.comments.changes()) return;
    if (previous.getValue('state') != '3' || previous.getValue('hold_reason') != '1') return;  // On Hold - Awaiting Caller
    if (gs.getUserName() == gs.getProperty('kb_assistant.service_user', 'svc_kb_assistant')) return;  // our own comment
    if (gs.getUserID() != current.getValue('caller_id')) return;  // only the caller can confirm their fix (AWS checks again)

    var endpoint = gs.getProperty('kb_assistant.webhook_url', '');
    var key = gs.getProperty('kb_assistant.signing_key', '');
    if (!endpoint || !key) return;
    var body = JSON.stringify({ sys_id: current.getUniqueValue(), number: current.getValue('number'),
                                event: 'caller_reply', version: String(current.getValue('sys_mod_count')) });
    var timestamp = String(Math.floor(new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue() / 1000));
    var signature = new GlideCertificateEncryption().generateMac(key, 'HmacSHA256', timestamp + '.' + body);
    try {
        var request = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2();
        request.setEndpoint(endpoint);
        request.setHttpMethod('post');
        request.setHttpTimeout(5000);
        request.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
        request.setRequestHeader('X-Timestamp', timestamp);
        request.setRequestHeader('X-Signature', signature);
        request.setRequestBody(body);
        request.executeAsync();  // don't make the caller's save wait on AWS
    } catch (e) {
        gs.error('KB Assistant reply webhook failed for ' + current.getValue('number') + ': ' + e);
    }
})(current, previous);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>svc_kb_setup</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-19 23:17:54</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>16556b99730cd71048fffb914ab8b7d5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>KB Assistant - caller reply</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_16556b99730cd71048fffb914ab8b7d5</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>svc_kb_setup</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-19 23:17:54</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=16556b99730cd71048fffb914ab8b7d5"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>incident</collection><condition/><description>When an approver approves or rejects an AI agent request, runs or cancels it.</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>KB Assistant - approval decision</name><order>1000</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[/**
 * Business Rule: "KB Assistant - approval decision"
 * Table: incident | Update: true | When: after
 *
 * When the AI agent has asked for approval (Approval = Requested) and an approver sets Approval to
 * Approved or Rejected, tell AWS who decided and what (signed). Recommended: an ACL so only approver
 * roles can write the incident's Approval field. The worker checks that this person is an authorized approver for
 * that request (right role, not the requester), then runs exactly the approved action, or tells the
 * caller it was rejected. Signed like the other rules; only ids are sent.
 */
(function executeRule(current, previous) {
    if (!previous || !current.approval.changes() || previous.getValue('approval') != 'requested') return;
    var decision = current.getValue('approval');
    if (decision != 'approved' && decision != 'rejected') return;
    // The person who made this change, captured now and signed: AWS never infers it from later edits.
    var approver = gs.getUserName();

    var endpoint = gs.getProperty('kb_assistant.webhook_url', '');
    var key = gs.getProperty('kb_assistant.signing_key', '');
    if (!endpoint || !key) return;
    var body = JSON.stringify({ sys_id: current.getUniqueValue(), number: current.getValue('number'),
                                event: 'approval', version: String(current.getValue('sys_mod_count')),
                                decision: decision, approver: approver });
    var timestamp = String(Math.floor(new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue() / 1000));
    var signature = new GlideCertificateEncryption().generateMac(key, 'HmacSHA256', timestamp + '.' + body);
    try {
        var request = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2();
        request.setEndpoint(endpoint);
        request.setHttpMethod('post');
        request.setHttpTimeout(5000);
        request.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
        request.setRequestHeader('X-Timestamp', timestamp);
        request.setRequestHeader('X-Signature', signature);
        request.setRequestBody(body);
        request.executeAsync();
    } catch (e) {
        gs.error('KB Assistant approval webhook failed for ' + current.getValue('number') + ': ' + e);
    }
})(current, previous);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>svc_kb_setup</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-19 23:19:27</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>78b567d9730cd71048fffb914ab8b753</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>KB Assistant - approval decision</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_78b567d9730cd71048fffb914ab8b753</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>svc_kb_setup</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-19 23:19:27</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=78b567d9730cd71048fffb914ab8b753"/></record_update>
